title: rx-leptos: CSR example app (typeahead, stopwatch, mouse tracker)
description: Leptos 0.8 CSR app under examples/leptos-csr demonstrating rx-leptos: debounced typeahead with switch_map cancellation and pending state, interval-driven stopwatch toggled by a signal, throttled mouse tracker via from_event. Reactive model kept in a view-independent module with native tests; CI checks the wasm32 build and runs the model tests. SSR deferred to rxRust-bnd.

title: rx-leptos: SSR support (server-safe bridges, hydrate/ssr features)
description: Deferred while the first Leptos example ships as CSR. Scope: make crates/rx-leptos usable in SSR/hydrate builds: verify from_signal (executor-scheduled reactive_graph node) behaves under tokio + hydration, decide what to_signal/use_observable do during server render (initial value only vs. resource-style), add an ssr example or feature-gated test, and document executor expectations on the server. Discovered during the rx-leptos spike (PR #8).
